timeline.summary: Magnum Ice Cream Company HoldCo 1 issued the offer opening advertisement for its 26% mandatory open offer at ₹21.33 per share.
Kwality Wall's (India) Limited published the open offer opening advertisement at ₹21.33 per share.
Kwality Wall's responded to IiAS and SES proxy voting recommendations regarding executive director appointments on May 11, 2026.
Kwality Wall's published the post-offer advertisement for Magnum's open offer on May 15, 2026.
Kwality Wall's announced the voting results of its postal ballot on May 15, 2026, approving all executive and independent director appointments.
Kwality Wall's board approved the appointment of Walker Chandiok & Co. LLP as statutory auditors for a 5-year term.
